encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

div.note: Append. proverb. 4, 77 συμβαλόμενος· κατ’ ἔλλειψιν καὶ αὕτη. ἐνδεῖ γὰρ εἰς ἔρωτα. μέμνηται ταύτης Ἀλέξανδρος (Ἀναξανδρίδης Bernhardy Jahrb. f. wissensch. Krit. 1837, 178). Athen. 15, 692 d (ind. Mein.) συμβαλοῦμαί τι μέλος ὑμῖν εἰς ἔρωτα, κατὰ τὸν Κυθήριον ποιητήν. Cyclopis exordium esse arbitratur Bergk. adparet Philoxeni locutione comicum usum et scribendum esse συμβαλοῦμαί σοι μέλος (συμβαλοῦμαι μέλος Mein.). Plat. Symp. 185 c ταῦτά σοι ... περὶ Ἔρωτος συμβάλλομαι. Dionys. Hal. Comp. verb. 1 συμβάλλομαί σοι μέρος (μέλος Mein.) εἰς τὸν ἔρωτα τὸ περὶ συνθέσεως ὀνομάτων.

θόλος οἴκημα στρογγυλοειδές ... οὕτως Ἀλέξανδρος. Zonaras 1047. Alexandrum Aphrodisiensem dici censet Tittmannus. — significari videtur prytaneum. adparet omnia Alexandri fragmenta admodum dubia esse.
